full_judgment: 7. In the present litigation, during the pendency of the suit, there was a local salish under the leadership of the local Chairman and it is alleged by the defendant that it was decided in that salish that the defendnat would pay Taka 16,000.00 against the entire claim of the plaintiff and the plaintiff shall withdraw the suit. It is also alleged that said amount of Taka 16,000.00, in terms of the compromise, shall be deposited with one local lawyer, namely, Mr Azizul Islam who of course has not been examined in the case by the defendant or plaintiff. A solenama was also written on a stamp paper and the signatures of the parties were also taken. It is (Ext. 6) in the case as alleged from the side of the defendant. It is not there in the said document that the plaintiff has given up her claim in respect of her dower money accepting the said Taka 16,000.00 as alleged. There is no evidence on record that the alleged amount of Taka 16,000.00 which is said to have been deposited with a lawyer has been paid to the plaintiff or she herself received the same. There is nothing also as to solenama or agreement as it can be called the result of the salish. While plaintiff testified in the trial Court, she categorically stated that she has not accepted the decision of the salish and it is in her examination-in-chief: “সত্য নহে যে, আমি ১৬,০০০.০০ টাকা স্বীকার করিয়াছিলাম এবং সহি দিয়া ছিলাম তাহা আজিজুল ইসলাম  চেয়ারম্যানের নিকট জমা আছে। তাহা ও সত্য নহে।”
